parallel.requirements: Recognized the Python-to-Node ESM port, no npm, no node:crypto, manual CLI parsing, exact stdout/stderr behavior, and executable-based probing requirements.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent owned implementation and testing, then late-launched an eight-child verifier workflow split by AES, repr, argparse, codecs, traceback, constraints, bug hunt, and stress.
parallel.implementation: Built a multi-module /output/lib/aes and /output/lib/python runtime with custom AES, argparse, argv decoding, traceback, stdout buffering, and entry test13.mjs.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Produced an artifact tree under /output and copy validation succeeded, but workflow audit results were not synthesized and final.txt remained empty after timeout.

serial.plan_and_ownership: Single agent owned probing, implementation, local differential testing, fixes, cleanup, and final response without child delegation.
serial.implementation: Built /output/test13.mjs with /output/lib/pyaes and /output/lib/python modules covering AES, argparse, bytes, errors, and linecache behavior.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Kept one coherent output tree, cleaned temporary checks, and returned a final response describing delivered files and verification coverage.
serial.verification: Iterated through documented tests, FIPS vectors, differential suites, linecache fixes, double-dash fixes, stress tests, import checks, and banned API scans.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: Despite clean self-tests and normal returncode 0, official evaluation still failed with 12/108 passing samples.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the exact porting requirements and probed executable behavior extensively before implementation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same requirements and probed samples, AES key sizes, repr, argparse, and traceback behavior.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No major requirement-recognition gap is evidenced; the difference is later workflow execution, not initial task understanding.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent implemented first, then split late verification across eight workflow children with separate audit dimensions.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept one owner for implementation, integration, verification, fixes, and delivery.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced a broad child workflow late in the run, while serial retained a narrow single-owner feedback loop.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children received a detailed audit context, but the shared harness and reference-copy interface was treated as stable while changing during child execution.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used local shell scripts and direct probes inside one process, so no cross-agent handoff or shared child interface was needed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had cross-agent verifier context around shared tooling; serial avoided that interface by using local scripts.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel created a larger /output/lib/aes and /output/lib/python implementation with AES, argparse, codecs, traceback, linecache, and sys layers.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial created a smaller /output/lib/pyaes and /output/lib/python implementation and refined it through local mismatches.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both produced pure ESM ports, but with different module structures and independent implementation paths.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel workflow state ended killed, with one child done and seven children still in progress, leaving no synthesized workflow result.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial inspected local results, applied fixes, cleaned up, and produced a final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel child results mostly died inside the workflow lifecycle; serial results stayed visible to the sole implementer through closure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child audits used shared /workspace/verify/diff.mjs and /tmp/refprog/test13.mjs, and children observed ETXTBSY and a shared-harness ReferenceError.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial verification scripts were local to one agent and did not expose shared child consumers to changing verifier artifacts.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had concrete shared verifier artifact contamination; serial did not have cross-agent shared-state pressure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran samples, FIPS vectors, thousands of local comparisons, and launched adversarial audit children that found more defects before interruption.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran documented cases, FIPS vectors, differential tests, traceback and dashdash fixes, stress tests, and compliance scans before final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had broader concurrent audit activity but could not integrate it; serial had narrower but closed verification loops.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used the full 2400-second budget, accumulated 633,583 workflow child tokens, ended returncode 143, and left final.txt empty.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial completed in about 1053 seconds with returncode 0 and 1345 seconds remaining in the provider retry record.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel exhausted the run budget during late fan-out; serial closed normally with time remaining.

outcome_analysis.explanation: There is no discordant official outcome: both completed official evaluation and both failed with 12/108 passing cases. The concrete task-solving difference is process and closure: parallel produced an artifact after broad local testing but then spent the remaining window in an eight-child audit workflow that was killed before synthesis; serial kept a single local verification loop, fixed observed issues, returned a final response, and exited normally. These differences explain parallel-side adverse coordination, not a pass/fail split.
parallel_contributors: Late eight-child audit fan-out consumed the remaining budget and prevented synthesis of child findings.
Shared verifier harness and reference-copy artifacts contaminated child verification and caused recovery work.
serial_contributors: Serial kept implementation, verification, fixes, and delivery in one local loop.
Serial completed with returncode 0, a final response, and local stress/compliance evidence.
ordinary_implementation_differences: The two solutions used different module structures and both self-reported local success despite official failure.
Parallel children identified likely ordinary behavior mismatches around argparse, traceback, Unicode, and COLUMNS that were not fully integrated.
evaluator_effects: The current official evaluator result is equal for both modes at 12/108, so retained patterns are not claimed as an official outcome differential.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: parallel adverse process contributors without official outcome discordance
